metric_name: 反贿赂/反贪污管理体系
query: 反贿赂/反贪污管理体系 反贿赂/反贪污管理体系 衡量企业是否建立并披露了正式的、覆盖全面的反贿赂与反贪污政策体系，以及该体系在董事会监督、适用范围与第三方管理方面的完备程度。 2分：企业同时满足以下三项标准。第一，披露了正式的反贪污/反贿赂政策或行为守则中的专门反贪污章节。第二，披露了董事会或专门委员会对反贪污合规的监督职责。第三，将反贪污要求延伸至第三方，例如对供应商或商业伙伴提出反贪污合规要求。 1分：企业满足上述2分标准中的任意一项或两项。 0分：企业在公开披露中未涉及任何反贪污政策或管理体系信息。或者，仅以“本公司禁止贪污贿赂行为”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何可验证的具体内容。 反贿赂 反贪污 反腐败 廉洁政策 行为守则 董事会监督 第三方尽调 疏通费 礼品招待 ABC anti-bribery anti-corruption ABC policy code of conduct board oversight of integrity third-party due diligence facilitation payments gifts and hospitality ABC 是否有正式反贿赂/反贪污政策或行为守则专章？ 董事会或专门委员会如何监督？ 要求是否延伸至供应商/商业伙伴？ 适用范围覆盖哪些员工与地区？ 有哪些培训、尽调或监控措施？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反贿赂/反贪污管理体系'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式反贿赂/反贪污政策或行为守则专章？ 董事会或专门委员会如何监督？ 要求是否延伸至供应商/商业伙伴？ 适用范围覆盖哪些员工与地区？ 有哪些培训、尽调或监控措施？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“禁止贪污贿赂”一句话；仅有举报热线；仅有未明确涉及反贪污的一般风险监督；仅有对外捐赠合规。区分：供应商反腐专题可计第三方延伸要素，但不能自动计企业政策或董事会监督；举报人保护关注渠道和反报复；道德采购关注多维采购标准。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: We are open, honest and ethical in all our dealings, and do not employ corrupt practices such as bribery or money laundering. Only gifts or hospitality that are reasonable and proportionate can be accepted or offered, and we do not make facilitation payments to speed up or secure the performance of a routine government action. Commission payments to business partners must also be justified by clear and demonstrable services they have rendered. With respect to money laundering, we track suspicious transactions such as payments between unknown entities through an excessive number of intermediaries, high-value cash transactions, or payments made or received by suspicious entities or involving high-risk countries. Any employee who suspects any such case has an obligation to report this to our compliance officers.

[Content]
We are open, honest and ethical in all our dealings, and do not employ corrupt practices such as bribery or money laundering. Only gifts or hospitality that are reasonable and proportionate can be accepted or offered, and we do not make facilitation payments to speed up or secure the performance of a routine government action. Commission payments to business partners must also be justified by clear and demonstrable services they have rendered. With respect to money laundering, we track suspicious transactions such as payments between unknown entities through an excessive number of intermediaries, high-value cash transactions, or payments made or received by suspicious entities or involving high-risk countries. Any employee who suspects any such case has an obligation to report this to our compliance officers.

We believe that each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries we operate in, and this commitment extends into the way we conduct business with our partners. results.text: Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

[Section]
Good Corporate Governance

[Content]
We respect the privacy of our customers, employees, business partners and other relevant individuals, and we strive to protect their personal identifiable information from abuse. Only where there is a legitimate business purpose is the personal data of individuals processed. In such an event, any processing of personal data shall be relevant to that business purpose and should be fair, accurate, transparent and in no way excessive. Employees are also expressly prohibited from compromising our or a third party's information and communication assets by, for instance, intentionally circumventing security measures to gain unauthorised access to systems or data; compromising any computer system; and creating an excess volume of messages.

For our inaugural Sustainability Report FY2019, we engaged an independent third-party to facilitate our materiality assessment process using a three-step approach. Since then, we have conducted a review of the identified material matters annually. Additionally, the existing topic 'Emissions (Air, Land, Water)' was expanded to also include disclosure on relevant climate-related issues, in line with the Stock Exchange requirements.

results.text: We conduct regular audits and reviews of our objectives and targets to achieve continual improvement of our OHS management system, and our OHS policies are communicated to all persons working for or on behalf of the company. Quarterly, at our business review meeting, we review the OHS statistics of our manufacturing partner factory. Our Human Resources office in China works closely with the Human Resources team of our manufacturing partner factory to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of work injuries and man days lost. Our customers have also been visiting our manufacturing partner factory and performing their own strict audits of the health and safety conditions for our workers.
